admin.scoringConfig.title: Scoring Configuration
admin.scoringConfig.description: Every number the ranking system uses. Add, rename, reorder or remove any of them. Saving drafts a new version and recalculates the seasons you choose.
admin.scoringConfig.loadFailed: Failed to load the scoring configuration
admin.scoringConfig.defaultsStaged: Shipped defaults loaded into the editor. Save to make them the live rules.
admin.scoringConfig.defaultsFailed: Failed to load the shipped defaults
admin.scoringConfig.versionStaged: Version {version} loaded into the editor. Save to make it the live rules.
admin.scoringConfig.statVersionSub: In force for the current season
admin.scoringConfig.statUnsavedSub: values differ from the saved version
admin.scoringConfig.statInSync: in sync with the saved version
admin.scoringConfig.statProblemsSub: {errors} would block a save, {warnings} to review
admin.scoringConfig.explainer: Edits are staged in your browser. Saving drafts a new version, pins every other season to the rules it was already scored under, and recalculates the seasons you pick. Nothing changes for anyone until you save.
admin.scoringConfig.makeOpenEnded: Remove the upper limit for this band
admin.scoringConfig.setUpperLimit: Give this band an upper limit
admin.scoringConfig.cannotRemoveLastBand: A scale needs at least one band.
admin.scoringConfig.cannotRemoveLastPosi: Placement points need at least one position.
admin.scoringConfig.cannotRemoveLastTier: At least one ranking tier is required.
admin.scoringConfig.tierRetireNotDelete: Events are already stored against this tier, so it cannot be deleted. Switch it to Retired instead: past events keep scoring and it stops being offered for new work.
admin.scoringConfig.tiersFootnote: The key is what each event stores, so it is fixed once saved. The name is free text and can be changed at any time.
admin.scoringConfig.modes.threshold.help: A team reaches a tier by clearing its minimum score. Tier sizes vary with how the season goes, and nobody has to reach the top tier.
admin.scoringConfig.modes.top_n.label: Top N on the ladder
admin.scoringConfig.modes.top_n.help: Each tier holds a fixed number of teams: the best N on the final ladder are the top tier, the next M the one below, and so on. Scores only decide the order.
admin.scoringConfig.defaultTierHelp: Everyone below every cutoff lands here. It always exists, so it has no cutoff of its own.
admin.scoringConfig.placementFootnote: Any position that is not listed scores 0.
admin.scoringConfig.finalsExample: {multiplier}x at {tier} gives {points} points per finals appearance
admin.scoringConfig.positionTaken: Position {position} is already in the table.
admin.scoringConfig.historyHelp: Every saved version is kept. Loading one stages its numbers in the editor; nothing changes until you save.
admin.scoringConfig.historyEmpty: Nothing has been saved yet, so the shipped defaults are in force.
admin.scoringConfig.dirtyFooter: {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} changed from the saved {version} rules.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.tiers.label: Tournament tiers
admin.scoringConfig.meta.tiers.help: Each tier's scoring multiplier and flat win bonus. The multiplier applies to placement points, kill points and the finals bonus; the win bonus is flat. Retiring a tier hides it from new rules but keeps past events readable.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.placement_point: Raw points for a single match finish. Any position not listed scores 0.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.kill_compressio: The band a team's kill total lands in decides the points, it is not additive. The last band must be open ended, with no upper limit.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.placement_compr: The band a team's raw placement total lands in decides the points. The last band must be open ended, with no upper limit.
cumulative raw placement points in one tournament
admin.scoringConfig.meta.finals_base.hel: Multiplied by the tier multiplier for each finals appearance.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.prize_money_poi: Thresholds are in Nigerian naira. A prize pool recorded in another currency is converted to naira before it is compared here.
total prize money won in the quarter
admin.scoringConfig.meta.social_media_po: Quarterly only, and only for a follower snapshot an admin has verified.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.tier_thresholds: How a team's ranking tier is decided. By score, a team reaches a tier by clearing its minimum quarterly score, so a tier can hold any number of teams. By top N, the tiers are fixed sizes: the best N teams on the season ladder take the top tier, the next M the one below. Either way a team below the participation floor gets the default tier and takes up no place.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.scrim.label: Scrim rules
admin.scoringConfig.meta.scrim.help: Scrim placement and kills are worth the scrim weight times their tournament value. The contribution is capped at the higher of the flat allowance and the share of the team's tournament points, so competing more never costs a team scrim points.
Flat points a player earns per MVP, finals appearance, team win, and so on.
admin.scoringConfig.meta.participation_f: The minimum number of tournaments needed to appear on a monthly ladder, or to be tiered on score rather than dropped to the default tier each quarter.
admin.scoringConfig.fields.scrim.cap_rat: Cap as a share of tournament points
admin.scoringConfig.save.title: Save scoring configuration
admin.scoringConfig.save.description: This drafts a new version from {version}, keeps every other season on the rules it was already scored under, and recalculates the seasons you choose. A reason is required for the audit log.
admin.scoringConfig.save.blockedTitle: These settings would break scoring, so they cannot be saved yet.
admin.scoringConfig.save.warningsTitle: These settings will save, but they may not do what you expect.
admin.scoringConfig.save.scopeHelp: The current season always recalculates, so it is never left half on the old rules. Tick any other season you also want rescored.
admin.scoringConfig.save.noOtherSeasons: There are no other seasons yet.
admin.scoringConfig.save.acknowledge: I understand that {seasons} will be rescored, and that standings people have already seen will change.
admin.scoringConfig.save.recalculateHelp: Recalculate the seasons in scope straight away. Leave this on unless you are saving several changes in a row and will recalculate at the end.
admin.scoringConfig.save.reasonPlacehold: e.g. Lowered the Tier 1 win bonus from 30 to 25 to close the gap between the top tiers (council vote 2026-05).
admin.scoringConfig.save.reasonLogged: Recorded in the ranking audit trail.
admin.scoringConfig.save.saved: Saved as v{version}. {seasons, plural, =0 {No seasons were recalculated} one {# season recalculated} other {# seasons recalculated}}.
admin.scoringConfig.save.failed: Failed to save the scoring configuration
admin.overview.title: Rankings & Tiering
admin.overview.description: Control the tournament data, evaluation, and seasons that drive the public rankings.
admin.overview.stats.transferNoWindow: No window set for this season
admin.overview.evaluation.blurb: Locks each team's tier for the next quarter from the current scores. Head Admin or Metrics Admin only.
admin.overview.publish.blurb: The public rankings and tier badges stay hidden until you publish them. Each surface is controlled separately - publish one without the other.
admin.overview.publish.tiersDesc: The locked tier badges (S / A / B / C).
admin.overview.publishDialog.rankings.pu: Makes the rankings visible to the public for this season. This does not change the tier badges.
Why are you publishing the rankings? (logged to the audit trail, min 10 characters)
Rankings published to the public for {season}.
admin.overview.publishDialog.rankings.un: Hides the rankings from the public again - the data is kept, just not shown. The tier badges are unaffected.
Why are you unpublishing the rankings? (logged to the audit trail, min 10 characters)
Rankings hidden from the public for {season}.
admin.overview.publishDialog.tiers.publi: Makes the tier badges visible to the public for this season. This does not change the rankings.
Why are you publishing the tiers? (logged to the audit trail, min 10 characters)

admin.overview.publishDialog.tiers.unpub: Hides the tier badges from the public again - the data is kept, just not shown. The rankings are unaffected.

Tiers hidden from the public for {season}.
admin.overview.evalDialog.title: Run quarterly evaluation
admin.overview.evalDialog.desc: Locks every team and player tier for the next quarter from the current scores. Preview the would-be result first (it writes nothing), then run to commit. Head Admin or Metrics Admin only.
admin.overview.evalDialog.alreadyRun: Evaluation has already been run for this season. Re-running will overwrite the previously assigned tiers.
admin.overview.evalDialog.reasonPlacehol: Why are you running the evaluation now? (logged to the audit trail, min 10 characters)
admin.overview.evalDialog.success: Evaluation locked {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}} and {players, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} for {season}.
admin.overview.recalcDialog.title: Recalculate a team / player
admin.overview.recalcDialog.desc: Re-derive a single entity's score from the source data. The recalc is queued and runs through the same pipeline as live edits, never inline.
admin.overview.recalcDialog.pickTeam: Pick a team from the list to continue.
admin.overview.recalcDialog.pickPlayer: Pick a player from the list to continue.
admin.overview.recalcDialog.reasonPlaceh: Optional note for the audit log (min 10 characters if provided).
admin.overview.teams.empty: No team scores for this season yet.
admin.overview.claims.rejected: Claim on "{name}" rejected. It is unclaimed again.
admin.overview.claimDialog.approveDesc: Approving transfers this ghost's historical results, stats, and prize money onto the claiming entity and recalculates the affected scores. This can only be undone with a revoke.
admin.overview.claimDialog.rejectDesc: Rejecting sends this request back to unclaimed. Nothing is transferred; the ghost can be claimed again.
admin.overview.claimDialog.warning: History re-attribution is retroactive across every affected month and season. If the real entity already shares a leaderboard with this ghost, the approval is blocked and must be resolved manually.
admin.overview.claimDialog.reasonPlaceho: Explain why, at least 10 characters. This is written to the audit log.

admin.seasons.table.empty: No seasons yet. Create the first season to get started.
admin.seasons.form.desc: Set the competition window and transfer window. The active season drives the public rankings.
admin.seasons.form.activeHint: Only one season should be active, this drives the public board.

admin.seasons.evalDialog.title: Run quarterly evaluation, {season}
admin.seasons.evalDialog.desc: This locks every team and player tier for the next quarter from the current scores, then publishes the results. Head Admin or Metrics Admin only.
admin.seasons.evalDialog.alreadyRun: Evaluation has already been run for this season. Re-running will overwrite the previously assigned tiers.
admin.seasons.evalDialog.reasonPlacehold: Why are you running the evaluation now? (logged to the audit trail, min 10 characters)
admin.seasons.evalDialog.reasonTooltip: Enter a reason of at least {min} characters.

admin.overrides.title: Overrides & Bans
admin.overrides.description: Manually correct tier assignments and zero out cheating teams or players. Every action is logged with a reason.
admin.overrides.stats.deductionsRemoved: {count, plural, one {# pt removed this quarter} other {# pts removed this quarter}}
admin.overrides.teams.empty: No evaluated teams for this season.
admin.overrides.teams.note: Deduct for partial penalties, ban-zero for total ones. A deduction subtracts a set number of points and leaves the team ranked, multiple deductions accumulate and can be reset. A ban-zero forces the team's score to 0 and the bottom tier for the whole quarter, it is not lifted by recalculation and stays until an admin explicitly restores the team.
admin.overrides.players.note: Players inherit their team's tier and are not individually overridden. The only manual action available here is a ban-zero, which removes a single player's contribution for the quarter (e.g. confirmed individual cheating) and recalculates their team.
admin.overrides.tierDialog.title: Override tier, {name}
admin.overrides.tierDialog.desc: Manually set this team's tier. The override sticks until you change it and is written to the audit log with your reason.
admin.overrides.tierDialog.sameAsCurrent: Same as the current tier, saving will clear any existing override.
admin.overrides.tierDialog.reasonPlaceho: Why is this tier being overridden? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)
admin.overrides.deductDialog.title: Deduct points, {name}
admin.overrides.deductDialog.desc: Subtract a specific number of points as a partial penalty. Unlike a ban-zero, this leaves the team ranked, the deduction is written to the audit log with your reason.
admin.overrides.deductDialog.amountInval: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}.
admin.overrides.deductDialog.reasonPlace: Why are points being deducted? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)
admin.overrides.clearDialog.title: Reset deductions, {name}
admin.overrides.clearDialog.desc: Removes the team's partial point penalty and restores its full derived score. The reset is written to the audit log with your reason.
admin.overrides.clearDialog.reasonPlaceh: Why are the deductions being cleared? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)
admin.overrides.banTeamDialog.title: Ban-zero {name}?
admin.overrides.banTeamDialog.desc: This sets the team's score to 0 for the current quarter and forces them to the bottom tier. Use only for confirmed cheating or manipulation (§16). The team stays zeroed until you restore it.
admin.overrides.banTeamDialog.reasonPlac: Why is this team being zeroed? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)
admin.overrides.restoreDialog.title: Restore {name}
admin.overrides.restoreDialog.desc: Lifts the team's ban-zero and lets the next recalculation recompute its score and tier from scratch. The restore is written to the audit log with your reason.
admin.overrides.restoreDialog.reasonPlac: Why is this team being restored? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)
admin.overrides.banPlayerDialog.title: Ban-zero player, {name}
admin.overrides.banPlayerDialog.desc: Zeroes this player's individual score for the current quarter and recalculates their team. They stay zeroed until restored.
admin.overrides.banPlayerDialog.reasonPl: Why is this player being zeroed? (min 10 characters, appears in the audit log)

admin.tournamentTiers.title: Tournament Tiers
admin.tournamentTiers.description: Decide how events are classified into Tier 1-3. Rules run top-down - the first rule a tournament matches sets its tier, which drives the scoring multiplier.
admin.tournamentTiers.loadFailed: Failed to load tournament tier rules.
admin.tournamentTiers.resetDone: Reverted to the saved classification rules.
admin.tournamentTiers.saveSuccess: Tournament tier rules saved; future events classify against the new rules.
admin.tournamentTiers.saveFailed: Failed to save tournament tier rules.
admin.tournamentTiers.emptyRules: No classification rules yet. Add a rule to start tiering events - until then everything falls through to the default tier.
admin.tournamentTiers.defaultRowText: Anything that matches no rule above
admin.tournamentTiers.explainer: First match wins. Drag the handle to set priority. Each rule combines conditions on prize pool, registered teams/players, and format (physical/LAN vs fully virtual). Tier multipliers are configured in Scoring Config (Tier 1 = 2.0×, Tier 2 = 1.5×, Tier 3 = 1.0×).
admin.tournamentTiers.currency.noRate: No exchange rate is stored for {currency}, so this condition cannot be compared and the rule matches nothing until one is.
admin.tournamentTiers.currency.fxNoteTit: One of your thresholds is not in naira.
admin.tournamentTiers.currency.fxNote: A threshold in a currency other than naira is converted to naira at the exchange rate in force each time an event is classified, so the events it matches can change as the rate moves. A threshold written in naira is fixed and never uses an exchange rate.
admin.tournamentTiers.stats.activeRulesS: {count, plural, one {# rule total} other {# rules total}} · evaluated top-down
admin.tournamentTiers.issues.title: Some rules need a second look
admin.tournamentTiers.issues.summary: {count, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}. Nothing is blocked and your rules still save. The usual cause is a rule that can never fire, because a rule above it already matches every event it would have matched.
admin.tournamentTiers.issues.savedNote: These warnings describe the rules as last saved. Save to check the edits you have on screen.
admin.tournamentTiers.test.title: Test a tournament
admin.tournamentTiers.test.blurb: Enter sample event details to see which rule fires and the tier it would get.
admin.tournamentTiers.test.convertFailed: No exchange rate is stored for {currency}, so a pool in that currency cannot be tested right now.
admin.tournamentTiers.test.noMatch: No rule matched - fell through to the default tier.
admin.tournamentTiers.saveDialog.title: Save tournament tier rules
admin.tournamentTiers.saveDialog.desc: Saving updates how every future event is classified into a tier (and therefore its scoring multiplier). Existing locked results are not retroactively re-tiered. Provide a reason for the audit log.
admin.tournamentTiers.saveDialog.reasonP: e.g. Raised the Tier 1 prize bar to ₦1M and required a physical stage.
admin.tournamentTiers.saveDialog.reasonL: Logged to the ranking audit trail.
